                            Full job description

                            Exciting opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects as an AI/ML Engineer. You will design and implement machine learning models, work with large language models, and develop AI-powered applications that solve real-world business problems.

                            Requirements:

                            • Python, TensorFlow/PyTorch, NLP, Computer Vision, LLMs, MLOps, Cloud ML services, Deep Learning, Research experience
